title: The diagonal of a locally finite type algebraic-space morphism is locally finitely presented
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Work with algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and with sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type, meaning locally of finite type on compatible etale scheme charts [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Then the relative diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ is locally of finite presentation, with local finite presentation tested on compatible etale scheme charts [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. No quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, separatedness, or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Put $P=X\times_YX$ and let $p_2:P\to X$ be the second projection. Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $v:V\to Y$, put $X_V=X\times_YV$, and choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $u:U\to X_V$, using [def-trf-algebraic-space, lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The composite $a:U\to X_V\to X$ is surjective etale by [lem-trf-space-representable-etale-scheme-tests]. Write $h:U\to V$ for the chart map. The chart criterion [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] applied to $f$ gives that $h$ is locally of finite type.

source.place: Tag 084P (lemma-diagonal-morphism-finite-type), first assertion; expansion of the base-change input using Tags 03XH and 03MJ.

proof.text: Base change the atlas $u$ along $h:U\to V$. This gives a surjective etale scheme chart $R=U\times_VU\to X_V\times_VU=X\times_YU=P\times_{X,p_2}U$, by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The equalities follow on each scheme test by dropping the repeated $V$-coordinate and, in the last expression, the second $X$-coordinate determined by $a:U\to X$. The map $R\to U$ is the second projection, hence a scheme base change of $h$ and locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-lft-base-change]. With target atlas $a:U\to X$ and source atlas $R\to P\times_XU$, [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] proves that $p_2$ is locally of finite type.

source.place: Tag 03XH (lemma-base-change-finite-type), locally finite type clause; applied in Tag 084P to the second projection.

proof.text: The identity $1_X$ is locally of finite presentation: take the target atlas $a:U\to X$ above and the identity atlas of $X\times_XU=U$. The resulting scheme chart map is $1_U$. At any point of $U$, take the same affine open on source and target; its ring map is $A\to A=A[\ ]/(0)$, a presentation with zero generators and zero relations [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Thus [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] gives the claim for $1_X$.

For every scheme test, $\Delta_f$ sends a section $x$ to $(x,x)$, so $p_2\circ\Delta_f=1_X$. Apply [lem-sfb-space-relative-lfp-permanence] with its maps $X\xrightarrow{\Delta_f}P\xrightarrow{p_2}X$. The composite is locally of finite presentation by step 3, and the second map is locally of finite type by step 2. Its conclusion is exactly local finite presentation of $\Delta_f$. None of these steps requires quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, separation or a Noetherian base.

The statement is identical to the live base (still unsplit there) and is exactly Stacks 084P's first assertion (spaces-morphisms.tex l.5640-5645): f lft implies Delta_f: X -> X x_Y X lfp, with no qc or qs hypothesis. Step 1: the atlas u: U -> X_V and the composite a: U -> X are surjective etale by the composition and base-change clauses of trf representable-tests; the chart test gives h: U -> V lft. Step 2: I recomputed P x_{X,p2} U = X x_Y U = X_V x_V U and R = U x_V U as the base change of u (fibre-products family clause). R -> U is the scheme base change of h along h, so the pbc 01T4 leaf applies verbatim, and the chart test gives p2 lft. Step 3: 1_X is lfp via the identity chart and the n=m=0 presentation in def-sbc. Step 4: 05WT node with Delta_f, p2 and Z=X; its hypotheses are exactly steps 3 and 2. The report's source-error note is correct: the 084P proof says the projection is 'finite type' where only 'locally finite type' holds (counterexample: infinite disjoint union over Spec k). Duplicate search found nothing: 084P/diagonal-lfp hits are only fp-etale-presentation-criterion, diagonal-locally-finite-type (03HK, weaker), nagata scheme fp diagonal, and the parent. Batch-5: representable-tests (03EC) is generic space calculus. Chart-test (03MJ) and relative-lfp-permanence (05WT) reach only def-trf-algebraic-space, a general definition. None is part of the trace formula or Poincare duality, so all are accepted, and the worker's tool_uses are accepted too. No SGA. Edge cases checked: X empty, f=1, schemes, non-qc unions, and a closed immersion that is not lfp.
